Class CodecSerde<T>

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.codec.kafka.CodecSerde<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serde<T>
public final class CodecSerde<T> extends Object implements org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serde<T>
A Kafka Serde pairing a CodecSerializer and CodecDeserializer over one codec, for Kafka Streams: 
KStream<String, Person> people =
    builder.stream("people", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), new CodecSerde<>(codec)));
